# hpe_morpheus_cluster_layout (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_cluster_layout" "example" {
  id = 7
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_cluster_layout" "example" {
  name = "Kubernetes Cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the cluster layout
- `name` (String) The name of the cluster layout

### Read-Only

- `cluster_version` (String) The cluster version associated with the layout
- `code` (String) The code identifier of the cluster layout
- `compute_version` (String) The compute version associated with the layout
- `creatable` (Boolean) Whether clusters of this layout can be created
- `date_created` (String) The date the cluster layout was created
- `description` (String) A description of the cluster layout
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this cluster layout is enabled
- `has_auto_scale` (Boolean) Whether the layout supports auto scaling
- `has_config` (Boolean) Whether the layout has additional configuration
- `has_settings` (Boolean) Whether the layout has additional settings
- `install_container_runtime` (Boolean) Whether the container runtime is installed by this layout
- `internal_id` (String) The internal identifier of the cluster layout
- `labels` (Set of String) Labels associated with the cluster layout
- `last_updated` (String) The date the cluster layout was last updated
- `memory_requirement` (Number) The memory requirement (in bytes) for this layout
- `server_count` (Number) The number of servers defined by this layout
- `sort_order` (Number) The display order of the layout
